title: Chicken and spinach gravy
description: Chicken simmered in a spiced onion-tomato base with plenty of chopped spinach, with flour tortillas used as chapati.
freeze_note: Freeze the gravy; warm the tortillas fresh when serving.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Freeze the gravy only.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Chop the onion and tomatoes. Grate the ginger and garlic.
Wilt the spinach in a large pot with a splash of water, about 2 minutes. Cool slightly, then chop finely.

Heat the oil over medium heat. Cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, cumin, coriander and salt; cook until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add the chicken and water, cover and simmer about 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped spinach and garam masala and simmer 3 minutes.
Warm each tortilla on a dry pan about 30 seconds per side, like chapati.
Divide the gravy among 4 containers, with 2 tortillas per serving packed separately.
Cool the gravy, then refrigerate. Keep the tortillas in their bag.
Reheat the gravy covered, stirring halfway. Warm the tortillas just before eating.
